about.title: Making sustainability something you can grow with your hands
about.vision: Greenomy makes sustainability and urban greening accessible through technology and community participation — one small plant at a time.
about.why: Most sustainability advice stays abstract. Greenomy turns it into a plant on your windowsill, a photo you're proud of, and points you can actually use.
about.circular: We encourage regrowing food scraps and seeds you'd normally throw away, turning kitchen waste into new life.
about.urban: Even a balcony or a windowsill counts. Greenomy helps cities grow greener, one household at a time.
about.community: Growth is more fun together. Members share progress, tips, and encouragement across the Greenomy community.

verify.title: Verify your plant
verify.lead: Take a photo of your plant. The checker looks for real greenery and a bright, sharp shot, then awards points.
verify.hint: Tip: fill the frame with leaves, keep it bright, and avoid blur.
verify.challengeLead: Write or show this code somewhere in the photo — it changes every time.
verify.noPlants: You don't have a plant yet.
verify.cameraUnavailable: Camera unavailable — you can choose a photo instead.
verify.cameraInsecure: The camera needs a secure (https) connection. Choose a photo instead, or open the site on localhost.
verify.pending: Not approved yet — sent for review.
verify.reasonNoPlant: We couldn't verify a plant in this image. Please upload a clear photo of your plant.
verify.reasonLikelySourced: This image appears to be downloaded or sourced from the internet. Please upload a photo you took yourself.
verify.reasonScreenshot: This looks like a screenshot rather than a photo of your plant. Please upload a photo you took yourself.
verify.reasonDuplicate: This photo has already been submitted. Please upload a new photo.
verify.reasonLowQuality: We couldn't verify this image as an original plant photo. Please upload a clearer photo taken by you.
verify.noPhoto: Take or choose a photo first.
verify.errFileSize: That image is too large — please choose one under 5 MB.
verify.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
